'''December 1999 Austin tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Austin, TX on 11 December 1999. [[Matt Lush]] won it. It is known from Brian Guthrie's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d142">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/1999-12-11-austin-tx-12-11-99-ecc-discussiond142/ austin-tx-12-11-99-ecc-discussion], DeckTech (Brian "Red 81" Guthrie, 11 December 1999). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/1999-12-11-austin-tx-12-11-99-ecc-discussiond142/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 11 December 1999
* '''Site:''' Austin, TX
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Players:''' 11
* '''Winner:''' [[Matt Lush]]
